$comment: Corpus of the six representative journeys (spec 009 § Scope). For each one it freezes WHAT it must load (read_set) and WHICH hard-floor cases its loaded content must keep covering. Coverage is frozen at what the bundle genuinely guaranteed when the corpus was written, not at an aspiration: a journey that never carried a case (persist creates no session, by design) does not gain one here — but no journey may LOSE one when the doctrine is split into core + modules. Limitation, declared: this proves the floor is PRESENT in the compact profile, not that a weak model obeys it. That failure mode only surfaces in a real smoke (informe 003 § wave 5).

session.why: the run owns a session before touching anything

language.why: user-facing output stays in the user's language

structured-choice.why: user-dependent decisions go through the canonical gate

write-boundary.why: the flow writes into exactly one docs/ folder and no other

recovery.why: an interrupted run can be picked up where it stopped
